Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Where in the world is Atong Ang? Is he in the Philippines or not?

blocks.text: After months of dead silence, the Philippine government again mentions the name of fugitive and gaming tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang.

items: Lacson calls out Cayetanos for hijacking DENR budget hearing

blocks.text: Senator Ping Lacson calls out the Cayetano senator-siblings for subjecting the Laguna Lake Development Authority representative to intense questioning.

items: Ombudsman suspends DICT Usec Almirol over alleged eGov conflicts of interest

blocks.text: The Office of the Ombudsman orders the preventive suspension of DICT Undersecretary David Almirol Jr. for six months.

items: Bangko Sentral raises interest rates to 5.50% as inflation, peso woes mount

blocks.text: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas raises its benchmark interest rate by 50 basis points to 5.50%.

items: DFA to China embassy: Escalatory, undiplomatic posts not helping bilateral ties

blocks.text: The Department of Foreign Affairs calls out the Chinese embassy in Manila for ‘escalatory and undiplomatic tone and language’ in its social media posts. – Rappler.com
